KVBC Fairlawn Starter

Topeka, KS · Road

KVBC Fairlawn Starter is a road group ride in Topeka, KS. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Pizagel's Pizza and Bakery, 29th and Fairlawn.

Next ride Sat, Oct 3, 9:00 AM CDT
Host's website↗ Add to calendar→ Google Calendar Text it · WhatsApp · Email

Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed on the host's own page. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

Kaw Valley Bicycle Club's public Google Calendar feed lists Fairlawn Starter as a weekly Saturday series at 9:00 am from Pizagel's starting Sep 19, 2026 (an 8:00 am series ran Apr 18 to Sep 19); the club's rides page says 8:00 spring/summer and 9:00 fall/winter, year round (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

Helmets required. Bring lights; rides are at your own risk and tentative, so check the KVBC Facebook page.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: mixed group that divides by speed and regroups at several stops. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the KVBC Fairlawn Starter group ride

A 14 to 15 mile Saturday ride for entry-level to intermediate riders. It starts and ends at Pizagel's. The group divides by speed and regroups at several stops.
